narrative: The afternoon's roll, cues beside a rule, no speech written out. The part is his. The strip does not say what to call it. He does not write a name in. He looks for a mark he meant to add and does not add it. The pack is already on the road. This roll is only the afternoon.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played, and did not name the part.

entities.name: The Two Gentlemen of Verona
entities.context: Shown on part in In it, and not named
